svg.text: 512K cartridge v2 - SST39SF040 flash with a 74HC377 bank latch
Pins with the same blue net name are connected. x = not connected. Drawn from the PCB file.
A15 = PB6, A16-A18 = the latch (a write to $0000-$3FFF). U3 only lets the flash drive the bus on reads. U4: latch clock = /CART OR A14.
